lead: eight licensed Kevin MacLeod expedition songs via PLANET_MUSIC.json
weapon_voices: removed from combat, shop preview and codex; legacy sources archived only
chart: per-song three-key themes, answers, refrains and cadences with explicit chord and roll partners. Relative four-bar energy selects variants, recorded offbeat attacks can replace spaced weak taps, and local sustain shapes hold releases. Opening half-time, staged gestures and real-time judgement windows are preserved.
song_rate: 1.00 plus 0.045 per finished objective, up to 1.18; OGG playback and score mapping advance together
inner_planet_phrasing: Venus uses longer sustains, Earth emphasizes doubled downbeats, Mars uses short accents and more ordered rolls
ammo: square(sum(all3keys earned)/sum(all3keys possible)) sets next6second base ammo; multiply current earnedPerfect bonus,max120percent;opening100percent;all eight campaigns floor base ammo at 50 percent, max drop 30 percentage points per scored window, rests and fraction carry retained
campaign_volley: first musical completion after charge. Short holds and ordered rolls use the tail. Multi-second ties retain a firing anchor at every original cue head inside the phrase. Each due salvo takes the base ammo of its scheduled six-second window and the active combo reward.
sustain: 123 multi-second phrases replace separate gestures in eight charts. Head and release are graded independently, internal held marks award 100, interruption preserves earned points. Each mark contributes a maximum of 100 to its own window. Only the completed gesture adds one combo.
campaign_preview: All eight campaigns use 3.80 s standard or 3.55 s hard preview before rate and pilot adjustments; minimum roll-key separation 55 ms.
song_mix: Set each OGG player to -22 integrated LUFS with at least 3 dB true peak headroom before the music and master faders.
mercury_difficulty: standard omits unaccented fourth-beat opening taps while retaining holds and accent cues; after beacon one skip beat four input in each bar, with some rolls simplified; six-second base ammo has a 50% floor and can fall at most 30 percentage points per scored window
standard_input: taps in chart rests preserve combo without awarding score; an extra input on an existing hold does not end it; an early roll tail can be retried after release before the original deadline
feedback: independent kill, pickup, shield, impact, UI, alert and rhythm buses; CC0 contact clicks, short midrange rim attacks and rising release tones; quiet ticks only on earned, timely internal hold checkpoints

rhythm_feedback.early_contact: immediate strike and displayed provisional grade, followed by one scored judgement without replaying the ordinary contact
rhythm_feedback.centered_contact: a Perfect within 45 ms adds a white strike accent and emphasizes existing rhythm samples by up to 1.2 dB before voice headroom and bus limiting; no new judgement grade
rhythm_feedback.volley_visual: actual nonzero volleys pulse beside the ship and on the ammo readout; no weapon voice is played

perfect_rewards.scope: immediate multiplier on accuracy-squared ammo, not points or damage; count caps remain

damage_growth: Central bounded attribute/level/modifier growth and full-count density sharing before score scaling. Accuracy itself only scales count. Utility dash missiles follow count ratio.
